verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਵਨ ਚੰਦਨ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਣਖੰਡ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਉਜਾੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: baavan cha(n)dhan birakh hoi vanakha(n)dd a(n)dhar vasai ujaaRee|

en.bdb: Being near the vegetation, it keeps its head down and remains engrossed in meditation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਸਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਲਾਇ ਉਰਧ ਤਪ ਤਾੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: paas nivaas vanaasapat nihachal lai uradh tap taaRee|

en.bdb: Getting attached to the moving breeze it spreads the superfine fragrance.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਵਣ ਗਵਨ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ਕਰਿ ਗੰਧ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਉਲਾਸ ਉਘਾੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: pavan gavan sanaba(n)dh kar ga(n)dh suga(n)dh ulaas ughaaRee|

en.bdb: Whether with fruit or without fruit, all the trees are made fragrant by sandal tree.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਸਮਦਰਸ ਹੋਇ ਕਰੇ ਵਣਸਪਤਿ ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: afal safal samadharas hoi kare vanasapat cha(n)dhan vaaRee|

en.bdb: The pleasure fruit of gurmukhs is the company of holy persons, which purifies the impure ones even in one day (sitting).

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਰੈ ਦੇਹਾੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal saadhasa(n)g patit puneet karai dhehaaRee|

en.bdb: It fills the evil persons with virtues and in its fold the people of fragile character become strong and firm.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਉਗੁਣ ਕੀਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਰੈ ਕਚ ਪਕਾਈ ਉਪਰਿ ਵਾੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: aaugun keete gun karai kach pakaiee upar vaaRee|

en.bdb: Neither water can drown nor fire can burn such people i.e. they go across the World Ocean and the flames of desires cannot reach them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨੀਰੁ ਨ ਡੋਬੈ ਅਗਿ ਨ ਸਾੜੀ ॥੬॥
verses.translit_en: neer na ddobai ag na saaRee ||6||

en.bdb: Neither water can drown nor fire can burn such people i.e. they go across the World Ocean and the flames of desires cannot reach them.
